meta.name: SpendSight Design System
meta.description: Authoritative design and implementation guide for SpendSight. This file is intended for AI agents and developers to generate new UI that feels native to the app.

color.intent: Calm, trustworthy financial dashboard with a cool, neutral base and sparing use of color for emphasis.

bg.canvas: bg-slate-50/80 or custom CSS var if configured

usage_rules: Default to neutral backgrounds and text; use green and blue accents only for key actions, positive states, and primary charts.
Reserve red and orange for destructive or warning states (errors, risky changes, alerts).
Charts should be mostly monochrome, with at most one accent hue for emphasis.
In dark mode, always ensure text or chart strokes have strong contrast (use currentColor plus appropriate Tailwind dark: overrides).

font_family.primary: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
font_family.numeric: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

body.lg.usage: Longer copy or more relaxed reading.

body.md.usage: Default body copy in cards and tables.

numeric.md.usage: Key numbers inside cards and tables.

implementation_notes.card_title: Use `text-sm font-semibold` or `text-base font-semibold` depending on prominence.
implementation_notes.numeric: Use `font-semibold tabular-nums` in headings or `font-medium tabular-nums` in tables.

rules: Avoid very large type jumps; keep the visual rhythm tight and data-dense.
Do not use all caps for long labels; restrict uppercase to tiny overlines.
Always use tabular-nums for numeric columns in tables and charts.

usage.page_padding: x: 24px, y: 24px–32px on main content areas.
usage.card_padding: 20px all around (Tailwind `p-5` or `px-6 py-6` in larger cards).

content.classes: max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 py-8 flex flex-col gap-6
content.behavior: Use stacked cards inside a responsive grid (1–3 columns depending on width).

secondary.usage: Supporting actions, e.g. `Cancel` alongside a primary button.

outline.usage: Low-emphasis actions that still need clear affordance.

ghost.usage: Toolbar actions and inline text buttons.

rules: Limit each view to one primary button where possible.
Use `ghost` or `outline` for secondary actions to keep the UI calm.

parts.root: bg-card text-card-foreground flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl border py-6 shadow-sm
parts.title: font-semibold leading-none

usage: Use cards for almost all dashboard content blocks (metrics, charts, tables).
Avoid nested heavy borders inside cards; rely on spacing and subtle dividers instead.
Use for statuses (`Active`, `Paused`), durations (`Last 3 Months`), and small metadata.
Do not overuse badges; they should highlight just a few key qualifiers.

input.class: h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px]

textarea.class: min-h-16 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-xs placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px]

switch.class: inline-flex h-[1.15rem] w-8 items-center rounded-full bg-input data-[state=checked]:bg-primary

rules: Labels should be left-aligned above the field (`text-sm font-medium text-foreground`).
Helper text goes directly below fields in `text-xs text-muted-foreground`.

header.layout: Top navigation bar as implemented in `web/src/app/layout.tsx`.
header.content: Logo at left, nav links center/right, theme toggle at far right.

usage: Place alerts at the top of the relevant card or page.
Keep copy concise: one short title + one sentence of description.

dialog.content_class: bg-background rounded-lg border p-6 shadow-lg max-w-lg w-full
usage: Use dialogs for irreversible actions or short workflows (e.g. export confirmations).
Do not open multiple dialogs at once.

table.header_cell_class: h-10 px-2 text-left text-sm font-medium text-foreground
usage: Keep tables visually simple with minimal stripes; use hover state and spacing to guide the eye.

tabs.list_class: inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-muted p-0.5
tabs.trigger_class: inline-flex h-[calc(100%-1px)] flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-2 text-sm font-medium data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:shadow-sm
usage: Use tabs to switch between high-level dashboard views (Overview, Cash flow, Categories).

style.bars: Use currentColor with classes like `text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100`.
style.grid: Thin horizontal gridline at 0 baseline; no heavy grid.

usage: Use for monthly or categorical comparisons.
Label the x-axis categories with tiny text (`text-[10px] text-muted-foreground`).

style.segments: Use concentric segments with decreasing stroke opacity for secondary slices.
style.center: Show total or primary metric in `text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums`.

usage: Limit segments to 3–5; group the rest into `Other`.

style.area: Optional gradient fill using currentColor at ~10–20% opacity.

usage: Use for trends over time (balances, spend curves).
Avoid over-annotating; show detailed values in tooltips or nearby text.

tone: Professional, calm, and trustworthy — like a modern banking or financial analytics tool.
Visual weight should fall on data and key actions, not chrome or decoration.
layout: Always preserve generous outer margins; avoid edge-to-edge content.
Prefer a grid of cards; each card should represent a coherent concept (a metric, a set of related metrics, or a table).
On wide screens, aim for 2–3 columns of cards; on small screens, stack cards vertically.
interaction: Hover states should be subtle: slight elevation, soft background tint, or border emphasis — no large color jumps.
Focus states must be clearly visible and meet accessibility contrast, typically via `ring-ring/50` and border color.
Animations (if any) should be soft fades or slides, never flashy or bouncy.
accessibility: Maintain sufficient color contrast for all text and key lines/shapes in charts in both light and dark modes.
Do not encode meaning with color alone; pair with labels, icons, or patterns when possible.
Ensure interactive elements have clear focus states and adequate hit targets (at least 40px tall).
ai_instructions: When generating new UI, reuse existing components from `web/src/components/ui` wherever possible instead of creating custom primitives.
Follow the spacing, typography, and color rules in this file; do not introduce arbitrary new scales or colors.
New features should fit into the card-based dashboard structure and feel like an extension of the existing `/` and `/design-system` pages.
Favor clarity and information density over decoration; every visual element should support understanding of spend, trends, or navigation.
